agentGuide: No key; the language is the one of the connection's address. Summary of an article: GET /api/rest_v1/page/summary/<Title> (title with underscores, URL-encoded). Full text as wikitext or HTML: GET /w/api.php?action=parse&page=<Title>&prop=wikitext&format=json. Search: GET /w/api.php?action=query&list=search&srsearch=<words>&format=json&srlimit=5. Plain-text extract: GET /w/api.php?action=query&prop=extracts&explaintext=1&titles=<Title>&format=json. Always add format=json on /w/api.php. Quote the article URL when you answer from it.
